description: One composer by slug: dates, portrait, catalogues (with chapters), stylistic movements with their work counts, and a summary of the works: counts by sub-genre and the top-level works (first 100) with their number of child works. Use search_works with the composer's name to page through every work.

slug.description: The composer's slug, as in https://klavierstuck.org/composer/<slug>, e.g. "frederic-chopin".
